confirmed_defect.description: The release script copied the retained PM2 process environment, including its unique_id, then required the new process to preserve that daemon-generated identity. PM2 generates a distinct UUID when preparing a process. The same mistaken check blocked both activation validation and recovery.
confirmed_defect.source_review: PM2 God.prepare assigns env.env.unique_id using Utility.generateUUID; the generator emits a lowercase UUIDv4. Both source files were inspected through the GitHub connector on 23 November 2026.
confirmed_defect.scope: Deployment helper only. The approved website application files are unchanged.

correction.behavior: Omit only inherited unique_id from candidate configuration. Require a distinct canonical UUIDv4 on the actual candidate, pin it only after complete configuration validation, and reject later identity drift. Preserve exact checks for every other expected runtime setting and ownership/launch field.
